# variants_zero_label_mismatch

Pins the streaming planner's variant-label emission against
regressing to the short ``<comp>-<opt>`` form. The bug-fix at
``template_graph/streaming/dispatch.py:155`` composes
``<binary>__<arch>__<comp>-<opt>-<flag>-<hardening>-san-<san>-march-<march>``;
without it, variant_lookup keyed by full sidecar form never
matches and ``plan_phase4_for_binary`` skips every variant
(producing zero ``build_variant`` descriptors).

**Tree**: 1 binary `hello` x 1 cell (`x86_64`, `gcc15`) x 2
variants differing only by opt (O0, O2). Both variants share
a single ``hello-2.12.drv`` child (becomes a common_dep node).

**Expected**: `build_variant_count == 2`. The harness asserts
the planner emits exactly 2 ``build_variant`` descriptors with
labels in full sidecar form.

**variant_lookup.json convention**: list-of-records,
``[{"key": [arch, label], "value": {...}}, ...]``. The harness
deserialises by tuple-keying on the list.

**tree.txt provenance**: generated by
``template_graph.tests.test_streaming.fixtures.render_tree``
with deterministic ``make_hash`` seeds. Hand-equivalent: the tree
shape is small enough to reproduce by feeding a 2-variant
``Node`` graph through ``render_tree`` (see
``template_graph.tests.test_streaming.test_basic`` for the same
shape pattern).
